mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as it signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate combined with weak payroll employment growth signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month AND PAYEMS 12mo growth < 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong economic growth, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as corporate earnings growth supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 3% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days, as it signals weak consumer demand and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation combined with declining industrial production signals stagflationary risks that increase uncertainty and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month AND INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production growth, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annualized growth exceeds 1.0% over a 5-year rolling window.
